notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
To celebrate the mobile release of the game, a new update is available.

This update brings a number of improvements:

[list]
[*] Improved performance
[*] Touchscreen support
[*] Enhanced avatars for characters during dialogue
[/list]

notes.title: Update number 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've heard you like doors... But, do you like Knights ??

In this update, discover a new Bonus chapter called "Knights and Doors". It contains 5 exclusives puzzles.

Warning, some side objectives are really hard ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: First update since launch (include Steam achievements)
notes.content:
What changes in this release?

[list]
[*]one new puzzle has been added on chapter 9 (more puzzles to come in the next weeks)
[*]French localisation has been fixed
[*]Steam achievements has been added (just launch the game to unlock those you already achieved)
[/list]

And what about the [b]Mac[/b] version?

The Mac OS support will be released monday! ːsteamthumbsupː ːsteamthumbsupː ːsteamthumbsupː
